categories.main_business_segments: Wens Foodstuff Group primarily engages in large-scale breeding and sales of broiler chickens and pigs, with additional operations in duck, layer hens, and pigeon breeding. The company also operates in related sectors including slaughtering, food processing, modern agricultural equipment manufacturing, veterinary drug production, and financial investment. Its business model integrates upstream breeding and feed production with downstream processing and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies in poultry and pig breeding, feed formulation, disease prevention, and intelligent farming. It employs a tight 'company + farmer' model, providing breeding stock, feed, veterinary drugs, and technical support to contracted farmers who raise the animals. Advanced genomic selection, gene editing, and smart measurement technologies are applied in breeding. The company also emphasizes environmental control and waste recycling technologies to promote sustainable farming.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Wens serves wholesale distributors, retail markets, food processing enterprises, and catering groups across China. Its main customers for live broiler chickens are wholesalers and retailers, while live pigs are sold primarily to wholesalers and meat processing plants. The company also supplies processed fresh and cooked products to community retail and large food service clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationwide in China with regional divisions covering South China, Northeast, East China, Southwest, Central China, North China, and Northwest. It has extensive breeding, processing, and sales operations distributed across these regions, adapting to local market demands and resource availability.
categories.supply_chain_position: Wens operates across the entire supply chain from upstream breeding and feed production, midstream animal raising via contracted farmers, to downstream slaughtering, food processing, and distribution. It controls core upstream technologies and manages downstream sales and marketing, positioning itself as an integrated agribusiness leader.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in breeding genetics, nutrition, disease control, environmental management, and digital transformation including AI and big data applications. It maintains a close 'industry-academia-research' collaboration model to drive innovation. Key projects include developing high-efficiency broiler and pig breeds, disease pathogen sequencing, odor control technologies, and smart marketing and risk control systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through sales of live animals (broiler chickens, pigs, ducks), fresh and processed meat products, feed, veterinary drugs, and agricultural equipment. The company uses a wholesale distribution model with direct sales to distributors and food processors. It also earns income from financial investments and related services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Wens is a leading modern agribusiness in China, ranking among the top in large-scale broiler and pig breeding. It holds a dominant market share in broiler chicken sales among listed companies and is second in pig sales. The company competes with other large-scale integrated livestock producers and maintains competitive advantages through its proprietary breeding technologies, extensive nationwide network, and integrated supply chain.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Wens reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 104.86 billion, a 16.64% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 9.23 billion, a significant turnaround from losses in the prior year. Total assets reached RMB 93.86 billion with steady growth. The company has demonstrated strong cash flow generation and improved profitability driven by volume growth and cost reductions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Wens emphasizes its proprietary breeding technologies, especially in yellow-feathered broiler chickens and lean-type pigs, enabling superior product quality and stable supply. Its 'company + farmer' model integrates smallholder farmers into a modern, technology-driven production system, enhancing efficiency and risk management. The company also focuses on sustainable and environmentally friendly farming practices, digital transformation, and extending the value chain into processing and branded products to differentiate itself.
